section: error (ILLEGAL ARGUMENTS) — 125.65-148.04 s, bars 67:4.5-80:1, lyric lines 83-85 (+ pick-up of line 86). Scene file src\scenes\10_error.js, copy in docs\v3\errors.json
summary: Nine shots, 48.5 beats, 100 % chat-UI, and the one place in v3 where the UI is the subject instead of the container. Alone in the empty offline chat the AI types one line of code (setPresence(you, "online");), the client scans it, turns the block's rule red (first red of the film, 129.34 s) and underlines the two arguments; on the keyword (131.22 s) a full-width error dialog carries ILLEGAL ARGUMENTS as its 132 px mono headline. Through the instrumental (135.2-147.7 s) fourteen more numbered errors arrive on a fixed schedule (1 per bar, then 2 per bar, then 1 per beat), each one reddening exactly one component while the camera changes scale every 4-8 beats (extreme close-up, 3-panel inspection, isometric tilt, low close-up) and the palette blends grey to red. It ends on the whole window with 15 chips docked and its outline traced red (145.73 s), a 0.23 s blackout fold, and a 0.69 s near-black "breath" that pre-positions the question bubble and a Regenerate pill for the v3 EXECUTION section. Screen corruption is a rule-based layer (growing RGB split, one row-tear per bar downbeat, three glitch/slice transitions). The only illustration is the OLD art used as a flat grey silhouette (parted.png) and an almost invisible blurred backdrop (rain.png).

diagnosis:
Why the director approves: in the rendered frames this is the section where the chat-UI concept pays for itself. (1) The interface is not a container for lyrics here, it is the thing that changes: one grey client is taken apart component by component and each of the 15 numbered errors visibly reddens ONE named part (send button, timestamp, presence chip, header, saved chats, new-chat, drawer, forged pointer, composer, forged bubble, spinner, spark, title bar, window frame). (2) It never looks like the same screenshot twice: nine shots, nine scales and geometries (wide, macro, medium + full-width dialog, 3x button close-up with a camera ride, three live inspection panels, isometric tilt, low close-up, annotated wide, black). That is exactly the variety the director misses elsewhere, achieved without leaving the UI. (3) Red is an event with a clear origin (the 5 px rule at 129.34) and a readable accumulation (grey -> red blend via stateK, counters 'refused x 31', 'overdue 00:00:15', badges 1-15), so the climax at 145.7-147.1 feels earned. (4) The corruption is motivated and dosed: steady RGB split growing 0.4->1.7 px, one row-tear per bar from bar 73, three torn transitions; it looks like a failing display rather than a filter, and it is switched off for the blackout. (5) Every word on screen is short, original and about love, and is large enough to read at 1080p (chip titles 22 px, codes 20 px, card bodies 20-23 px; verified at full size).

What the frames show as weak (all small, consistent with 'keep or polish slightly'): the only illustration is the old anime figure as a grey alpha silhouette, most visible in err-drawer and, magnified 3x, as a shapeless hem band in err-send; the first half of err-send is the emptiest composition and sits right after the keyword slam; the 0.5 s camera ride at 134.61-135.11 loses about half its contrast because the ghost passes repaint the wall and the window glass over the main pass; the visual corruption peak is spent on the transition INTO err-window (144.34-144.57) while the dramatic peak (15th error, frame outline, 145.73) gets no accent and is followed by ~0.9 s of an almost unchanged frame; the two most on-theme errors (#12 ERR_UNRESOLVED_LOVE, #15 ERR_LOVE_OVERFLOW) get the least emphasis (#12 arrives under the heaviest glitch and folds after 2 beats, #15 is the same size as every other card); and the last 0.69 s is a set-up for a Regenerate concept that v4 is abandoning.

It shows in err-request (head above the window), err-first (right edge), err-drawer (most visible, upper right), err-window (right edge and below) and, at zoom 3 in err-send, as a soft jagged hem band over the bottom third. The new art are BUSTS (1086x1448, cut at the chest; no.1 is 1254x1254), so the rect and the err-send framing must be redone, not just the file name. Candidates: 圖片/Claude娘剪影/...01_31_04-3.png (profile, eyes hidden, turned away) for the waiting figure behind the glass; ...01_31_06-4.png (frontal, face blacked out) for the 15-of-15 peak or the blackout. Use them as a single grey tone from the alpha matte to respect 'room stays grey, red only on the interface' (their orange hair would break the section's colour rule), and threshold the alpha: the PNGs carry stray red/yellow fringe pixels around the edge.

err-send first half (133.27-134.61) is the weakest frame of the section: ~55 % empty, a pulsing button, one card, and the unidentifiable silhouette hem at the bottom, placed directly after the keyword slam while line 85 is still being sung (to 135.22) with the keyword reduced to a 30 px chip.

err-send camera ride (134.61-135.11, 10_error.js:481): the two motion-blur ghost passes call world() with the backdrop and the 0.84-alpha window glass, so they repaint the wall over the main pass (alpha 0.4 + 0.22). Frames at 134.62, 134.80, 134.98 are a washed, triple-printed low-contrast image rather than motion blur. Fix direction: draw ghosts before the main pass, or with { bd: false } and no window fill.

Peak placement in err-window: the strongest corruption (glitch transition + bar-78 tear, 144.34-144.57) precedes the content peak. The 15th error and the frame outline (145.73) get only the 0.5 s trace; after the bar-79 tear (146.19, gone by ~146.6) frames 146.66 / 146.89 / 147.11 are near-identical (only the send-button burst and echo rings creeping 15 px/s). 'Feeling exceeds its window' is stated in text but the outline barely leaves the window. Room for ONE single-event accent (faster/larger overflow of the outline past the frame, a micro push, or the unused fx.mosh) on 145.73 or 146.19, without pulsing.

Emphasis of the on-theme errors: #12 'Love did not resolve' (ERR_UNRESOLVED_LOVE) arrives at 144.34 under the heaviest glitch (unreadable until 144.57) and folds at 145.27; #15 'Feeling exceeds its window' (ERR_LOVE_OVERFLOW) is the same size as any other card (err-window toasts use sc: 1, body 20 px, smaller than the 1.14 used elsewhere) and sits low over the composer. In err-window several chips also cover the labels of what they flag (chip 7 on New chat + first sidebar rows, chip 6 on the last row, chips 1 / 11 / 8 on drawer row labels) and leaders cross text; acceptable as a red wall, but nothing in it is singled out.

err-breath (147.34-148.04) is content-wise a v3 set-up: question bubble at the exact position of exec-01's ask() and a Regenerate pill at exec's pager rect (PG, 1592/73/204/52). With EXECUTION redesigned as a non-UI code loop both become orphans. It is also 95 % empty, its elements are 22-28 px in corners, and the first EXECUTION shout (147.66) starts over it with no visual answer until 147.80 (a 21 px icon turning red). Minor, same family: in err-request the 'send' event at 128.19 is carried by 15-17 px elements in a wide shot (it is recapped large in err-check 0.46 s later).

CONSEQUENCE FOR v4. With EXECUTION becoming a non-UI, code-style infinite loop, the fold (147.11-147.34) can stay exactly as it is, but err-breath's two props (question bubble, Regenerate pill) and their matched positions lose their target and should be re-authored as the bridge out of the UI. Material already on screen that is native to a code look: the 15 mono error codes (ERR_NOT_YOURS ... ERR_LOVE_OVERFLOW), the request line setPresence(you, "online");, the counters 'refused x 31' and 'overdue 00:00:15', and the red window outline. Natural options: let the chips' mono codes survive the blackout and stack into a log / stack trace that becomes the first lines of the loop; or let the outline collapse to a caret or prompt line. Whatever is chosen should (a) put its first visible stroke on the vocal pick-up at 147.66 rather than at 147.80, (b) keep the hard change on bar 80 (148.04), (c) keep the 0.2-0.3 s of real darkness after the fold, since the red wall followed by black is what makes the next section's first frame land, and (d) carry the 'refused x N' idea forward if the loop wants a counter, because the self-pressing send button has already established 'the same call, again and again' 30 times in this section.
